description: Phase 1 performance budgets for the Architech public prototype. Route first-load budgets stay tight; total/largest static JS budgets allow one lazy MapLibre chunk for the map/list experience. The total-static-JS cap was re-baselined to 2.1 MiB on 25 Aug 2026 to accommodate two added authenticated product surfaces (a saved-searches page and a functional broker listing-draft form); per-route first-load and core-web-vital targets remain unchanged.
